pages.title: Breath for the Forge
pages.text: Tamed human dragons at stage three or higher can power a matching forge. Build it, add materials, and bring the dragon to its input.$(br2)Wander, sit, or follow nearby. Keep its mouth close to the input with a clear view; use the matching element.

pages.title: When Work Stops
pages.text: Danger, sleep, or injury pauses work. If it remains seated, check the ingredients, output, and distance to the input.$(br2)A newly recovered companion waits for your next command.
